parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
    SELECT
        LOWER(BTRIM($1::text)) AS order_code,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            COALESCE($2::text, ''),
            '\D', '', 'g'
        ) AS phone
),

matched_order AS (
    SELECT o.*
    FROM public.orders o
    CROSS JOIN input i
    WHERE LOWER(BTRIM(o.order_code)) = i.order_code
      AND REGEXP_REPLACE(
            COALESCE(o.customer_phone, ''),
            '\D', '', 'g'
          ) = i.phone
    ORDER BY o.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),

addons AS (
    SELECT
        oa.order_id,
        JSONB_AGG(
            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'productId', oa.product_id,
                'productName', oa.product_name,
                'unit', oa.unit,
                'quantity', oa.quantity,
                'unitPriceEGP', oa.unit_price_egp,
                'designExtraEGP', oa.design_extra_egp,
                'totalEGP', oa.total_egp
            )
            ORDER BY oa.id
        ) AS items
    FROM public.order_addons oa
    WHERE oa.order_id IN (
        SELECT id FROM matched_order
    )
    GROUP BY oa.order_id
),

images AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_id,

        COALESCE(
            JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'id', oi.id,
                    'imageType', oi.image_type,
                    'fileName', oi.file_name,
                    'objectKey', oi.object_key,
                    'mimeType', oi.mime_type,
                    'fileSizeBytes', oi.file_size_bytes
                )
                ORDER BY oi.id
            ) FILTER (
                WHERE oi.image_type = 'cake'
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS cake,

        COALESCE(
            JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'id', oi.id,
                    'imageType', oi.image_type,
                    'fileName', oi.file_name,
                    'objectKey', oi.object_key,
                    'mimeType', oi.mime_type,
                    'fileSizeBytes', oi.file_size_bytes
                )
                ORDER BY oi.id
            ) FILTER (
                WHERE oi.image_type = 'deposit'
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
        ) AS deposit

    FROM public.order_images oi
    WHERE oi.order_id IN (
        SELECT id FROM matched_order
    )
      AND oi.is_active = TRUE
      AND oi.deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
)

SELECT
    (o.id IS NOT NULL) AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN o.id IS NULL
        THEN 'لم يتم العثور على طلب مطابق لكود الطلب ورقم الموبايل.'
        ELSE 'تم العثور على الطلب.'
    END AS message,

    CASE
        WHEN o.id IS NULL THEN NULL

        ELSE JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'id', o.id,
            'orderCode', o.order_code,
            'name', o.customer_name,
            'phone', o.customer_phone,
            'moderatorName', o.moderator_name,

            'fulfillmentMethod', o.fulfillment_method,
            'city', o.city,
            'area', o.area,
            'addressDetails', o.address_details,

            'deliveryDate',
                TO_CHAR(o.delivery_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
            'deliveryTimeFrom', o.delivery_time_from,
            'deliveryTimeTo', o.delivery_time_to,

            'cakeType', o.cake_type,
            'cakeSize', o.cake_size,
            'dimensions', o.dimensions,
            'numberOfTiers', o.number_of_tiers,
            'filling', o.filling,
            'covering', o.covering,
            'details', o.details,

            'basePriceEGP', o.base_price_egp,
            'cakeDesignExtraEGP', o.cake_design_extra_egp,
            'addOnsTotalEGP', o.addons_total_egp,
            'addOns', COALESCE(a.items, '[]'::jsonb),

            'deliveryFeeEGP', o.delivery_fee_egp,
            'discountType', o.discount_type,
            'discountInputValue', o.discount_input_value,
            'discountAmountEGP', o.discount_amount_egp,
            'totalOrderEGP', o.total_order_egp,

            'depositEGP', o.deposit_egp,
            'remainingEGP', o.remaining_egp,
            'orderStatus', o.order_status,
            'orderSummary', o.order_summary,

            'submittedAt', o.submitted_at,
            'createdAt', o.created_at,
            'updatedAt', o.updated_at,

            'images', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'cake', COALESCE(i.cake, '[]'::jsonb),
                'deposit', COALESCE(i.deposit, '[]'::jsonb)
            )
        )
    END AS "order"

FROM (SELECT 1) AS seed
LEFT JOIN matched_order o ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN addons a ON a.order_id = o.id
LEFT JOIN images i ON i.order_id = o.id;
